Class WorkbenchPqc

java.lang.Object
global.thalion.ttio.workbench.pqc.WorkbenchPqc
public final class WorkbenchPqc extends Object
Workbench client post-quantum protection (ML-KEM-1024).

A thin surface over the core PostQuantumCrypto. PQC support is preview-gated: every entry point refuses unless the caller passes preview=true, mirroring the server's opt_pqc_preview feature-flag gating (spec Decision 9).

The per-AU encrypted-upload path (WorkbenchClient.uploadEncryptedPqc / downloadDecryptedPqc) wraps a per-run DEK under an ML-KEM-1024 encapsulation public key and carries it in the transport ProtectionMetadata packet. This class supplies the keypair generator and the preview gate that path uses; the wrap/unwrap itself lives in EncryptionManager.

Cross-language equivalent: Python ttio.workbench.pqc.
